typesense:explore.greeting:
Rain streaks down the windshield in heavy sheets. The wipers work steadily against the cold. Inside the van it smells like damp fur, old upholstery, and the mix of everyone’s scents.

Gus is in the driver’s seat, both paws on the wheel, ears angled slightly back as he watches the dark, wet road. Alex is half-sprawled in the passenger seat, seat leaned back, one arm behind his head, looking like he could fall asleep any second. In the middle row Barbara is scrolling on her phone with the brightness up, occasionally kicking the back of the passenger seat for no reason. Linda sits quietly in the far corner of the middle row, hoodie up, earbuds in, staring out at the rain.

Gus glances at the rear-view when he notices you’re awake.

“Still a couple hours till the next real town. You need anything or you good?”

Alex just gives a slow thumbs-up without opening his eyes. Barbara waves the bag of snacks she’s eating from. Linda doesn’t look over, but her ear flicks once in acknowledgment.

The van keeps moving through the rain. No one has a fixed plan. They’re just driving.
typesense:explore.name: Furry Friend Group
typesense:explore.title: For Furries/Anthros Only (Road Trip)
